title: update-response
description: GET /agent/v1/updates/{version}: the release's manifest exactly as signed (base64, so not one byte changes in transit) and its detached signature. The package zip itself is GET /agent/v1/updates/{version}/package. The server answers only a cabinet the current batch of a running rollout has offered this version to. The agent trusts none of it until the broker has checked the signature against its own compiled-in key.

manifest.description: Base64 of the manifest's exact bytes (at most 4 KB).
